title: Sharp Cost of Learning Horvitz-Thompson Precision near the Unit Second-Moment Ceiling
banked_reason: D0.5 mathematics and decision panels PASS; projected paper-score ceiling 6.4 < 7.4 field floor, incremental and not salvageable within the sole authorized opportunity; independent MAIN validity confirmed.
gap_reasons: The delivered increment is the coefficient-one joint limit; the identical model, matched-order rate, budget-blind adaptation and null behavior are already credited to the prefix-frontier donor. The internal donor and archived proof spine are disclosed non-archival sources whose theorem contents were not independently verified; that limitation alone does not block the floor. The public [Noarov theorem](https://arxiv.org/html/2502.17427) requires a per-row combined-energy floor and does not settle this prefix-constrained game with paired zero rows. The selected-record conditioning bound, global hazard inequality and narrow-contrast reserve charge discharge the stated converse bottleneck, so the matched headline is not resting on an open conjecture. That narrow scope and constant-only increment constrain the projected leading-econometrics score to 6.4; they do not establish a broadly applicable experimental-efficiency frontier. proof_attempt_summary: The revived single-opportunity proposal delivered twelve manuscript-level proved nodes, including coefficient-one joint minimax regret, a horizon- and budget-blind anytime policy, and the unrestricted selected-record converse. Both D0.5 correctness panels passed without findings, but the whole-paper referee assigned incremental tier with ceiling 6.4 below the fixed field floor 7.4; independent main validity confirmed no authorized scoped lift. No mathematical claim was refuted, no Lean formalization was attempted, and future re-raise requires substantive new mathematics rather than an identical retry.
tldr: The exact joint minimax cost of learning raw Horvitz--Thompson precision is \(q\log(Tq)\), with coefficient one, on a mathematical stress-test class in which both arms stay near the unit second-moment ceiling in every ordered prefix, \(q\to0\), and \(Tq\to\infty\). One original-feedback anytime allocation knows neither the horizon nor the deficit budget and has zero excess regret at the unit-energy null. The converse retains the empirical best constant allocation and covers arbitrary randomized measurable policies with propensities arbitrarily close to either endpoint. The capped selected-record information theorem proves that conditioning the prefix-legal block prior preserves the required selected-observation information coefficient. The matched-order rate, deficit-blind learner and null behavior are credited to the occupied same-model proposal; the contribution is the unrestricted sharp joint constant.
gap: The occupied prefix-deficit precision-frontier proposal already treats the identical deterministic class and claims matched-order \(q\log(1+Tq)\) rates, an anytime deficit-blind learner and exact null regret. Sharp constants are delegated there. Published Noarov et al. give nearly logarithmic raw-HT regret under a per-unit combined-energy floor. The every-prefix armwise near-ceiling condition here is a newly maintained modeling restriction permitting paired zero rows, while reciprocal online-variance methods supply the inherited allocation machinery. Those results do not evaluate the unrestricted coefficient in this joint rare-deficit game.
fill: The core binds coefficient one, a single budget- and horizon-blind attainer, and an all-policy empirical-oracle converse. Explicit finite upper and lower inequalities expose the selected-information coefficient, cap-hazard error and squared-contrast reserve charge. They must remain adequate along every joint sequence, including arbitrarily slow divergence of \(Tq\). The consumer is the design-based adaptive-precision literature: the legal synthetic schedules test which curvature and information reductions preserve the leading overhead.
